queries: WITH linked AS (SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), deviations AS (SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, acl_igm - (SELECT AVG(acl_igm) FROM linked) AS deviation FROM linked), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.average_deviation AS excess_deviation FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.average_deviation ORDER BY excess_deviation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH linked AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), deviations AS (SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, acl_igm - AVG(acl_igm) OVER () AS deviation FROM linked), ranked AS (SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS excess FROM deviations) SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation, excess FROM ranked WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND deviation > deviation - excess ORDER BY (excess IS NULL), excess DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH joined AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(acl_igm) AS mean_igm FROM joined), deviations AS (SELECT j.ID, j.SEX, j.acl_igm, j.acl_igm - o.mean_igm AS deviation FROM joined AS j CROSS JOIN overall AS o), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX), ranked AS (SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.avg_deviation AS excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX COLLATE BINARY) SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation, excess FROM ranked WHERE excess > 0 ORDER BY excess IS NULL, excess DESC LIMIT 10;
